nodes.label: ADS1299 (24-bit ADC upgrade)
nodes.rationale: Upgrade path to 24-bit, 8-channel SPI ADC; PC protocol kept backward compatible where possible.

nodes.label: ADC1 (12-bit)
nodes.rationale: ADC prescaler /6 -> 12 MHz because ADC clock must stay <=14 MHz.

nodes.label: USART1 (921600 baud)
nodes.rationale: Baud jumps to 921600 for binary framing because 115200 is too slow.

nodes.label: STM32 Clock Tree
nodes.rationale: 72 MHz gives headroom, a clean 48 MHz USB option, and a 72 MHz timer clock for accurate sample rate.

nodes.label: TIM3 TRGO (F103 ADC trigger)
nodes.rationale: F103 ADC1 has no TIM2-TRGO trigger; its timer-TRGO option is TIM3, so TIM3 paces the ADC.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: STM32 Firmware (TIM-ADC-DMA-UART)
nodes.rationale: Do not sample in a while(1) HAL_Delay loop; a hardware timer must trigger the ADC for jitter-free timing.

nodes.label: EMG SAW Token Policy
nodes.rationale: Reduce token use in SAW sessions without weakening any quality gate; QUALITY_BAR.md wins on conflict.

nodes.label: Token reduction benchmark
nodes.rationale: Skipped below 5000 words because for small corpora the graph value is structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: FalkorDB export
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time with no bulk script import, so pushing directly is preferred over the portable cypher.txt artifact.

nodes.label: Wiki export
nodes.rationale: Must run before cleanup so .graphify_labels.json is still available.

nodes.label: Watch debounce
nodes.rationale: Waits until file activity stops before triggering so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: Confidence score rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric values are used instead of a continuous range because models collapse continuous ranges into a bimodal distribution.

nodes.label: Node ID format
nodes.rationale: IDs must include every path segment and be deterministic from the label so re-extraction matches existing nodes instead of creating orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion (vocab)
nodes.rationale: The matcher has no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language match, so a mismatched vocabulary returns 0 hits; expanding against the actual graph vocab fixes this without inventing tokens.

nodes.label: Whisper domain-hint prompt
nodes.rationale: A one-sentence domain hint composed from top god-node labels primes Whisper without a separate API call.

nodes.label: build_merge (replace-on-re-extract)
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction (calls, implements, imports) is always preserved.

nodes.label: MCP server
nodes.rationale: Exposes graph tools over stdio so other agents can query the graph live.

nodes.label: Post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit and works with any editor, so no background process is needed.

nodes.label: reflect / LESSONS.md
nodes.rationale: Lists preferred sources, known dead ends, and prior corrections so sessions learn from earlier ones; --if-stale keeps it cheap.

nodes.label: save-result work memory
nodes.rationale: Closes the feedback loop so the next --update extracts the Q&A as a graph node and future queries improve.

nodes.label: Transcribe video/audio
nodes.rationale: Video/audio cannot be read directly, so they are transcribed to text and then treated as doc files.

nodes.label: cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-cluster/rename/regenerate that must not re-run Steps 5-9 because their intermediate files were already deleted by a prior build's cleanup.

nodes.label: Incremental update
nodes.rationale: Only re-extracts changed files to save tokens and time; code-only changes skip semantic extraction entirely.

nodes.label: graphify clone (GitHub)
nodes.rationale: Clones into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs (cross-repo)
nodes.rationale: Each node in the merged graph carries a repo attribute so results can be filtered by origin.
